q: The oil used in the motor car's brake system is compressible. (2024)
e: Liquids, including motor car brake oil, are virtually incompressible.

q: The viscosity of liquids increases rapidly with an increase in temperature. (2024)
e: The viscosity of liquids decreases rapidly with an increase in temperature.

q: The viscosity of gases increases with an increase in temperature. (2025)
e: The viscosity of gases increases as temperature rises due to increased molecular collisions.

q: Motor car brake oil is considered to be compressible. (2025)
e: Motor car brake oil is considered to be incompressible.

q: Cohesion refers to forces between molecules of different substances. (2025)
e: Cohesion refers to the attractive forces between molecules of the same substance.

q: The SI unit of viscosity is newton per metre squared. (2026)
e: The SI unit of viscosity is poiseuille (Pl) or newton second per metre squared.

q: A fluid with low viscosity flows easily. (2026)
e: Low viscosity indicates less resistance to flow, allowing the fluid to flow easily.
